title: Weather observer injured in an encounter and given a medical discharge
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Weather observer injured in an encounter and given a medical discharge, about 1960s at Indian Springs ranges, Nevada, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: One observer was even injured in an encounter with something and given a medical discharge.

plain: Charles Hall is a former Air Force weather observer who says that in the 1960s, on the Indian Springs bombing ranges in Nevada, he spent years in contact with tall white aliens. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that one of the weather observers there was even injured in an encounter with something and was given a medical discharge from the service. He raises it as a sign that what happened at those ranges had real consequences for the men stationed there.
